# MC-15: Affiliate pilot research - TikTok Shop and Shopee in Vietnam: who may join, what it pays, what the law and the platforms require, and which content the company can make that earns

- Source: local://research/ceo-decision-record.md#ceo-d-1300
- Issue type: Research   Priority: Highest
- Labels: research, affiliate, tiktok-shop, shopee, vietnam, pilot, pivot
- Routed as: /research

## Description

AFFILIATE PILOT RESEARCH — TIKTOK SHOP AND SHOPEE, VIETNAM

### WHY — THE OWNER'S DECISION OF 2026-10-26 (`CEO-D-1300`)

The owner judged that the video the company has built toward cannot earn money on the path the plan set, and decided that the company **focuses on affiliate revenue**, with **TikTok Shop affiliate and Shopee Affiliate in Vietnam** as the pilot that becomes the model. Research comes first; nothing is built, no account is opened and nothing is downloaded until the owner approves this research's recommendation. Waves 12 and 13 are frozen, not cancelled.

### WHAT THE COMPANY ALREADY HOLDS — START HERE, DO NOT REPEAT IT

- `research/platform-policy-dossier.md`: TikTok Shop affiliate **US** rules (1,000 followers, identity verification, posting limits; a pilot page calling 5,000 the "traditional requirement"), TikTok's disclosure rule for Shop creators, TikTok Creator Rewards excluding Vietnam. **Nothing first-party for Vietnam.**
- `research/language-market-analysis.md` §7.4: Shopee commissions ~1–8% by category and a 5% fee from February 2026, both **[THIRD-PARTY]**; Lazada for comparison.
- `research/ceo-decision-record.md`: `D-018` (individual creator), `D-021` (Vietnamese disclosure law unestablished; affiliate disclosure is a standing rule), `D-002` (every publication approved by the CEO), and `CEO-D-1300` with the decisions it reopens.
- The delivered pipeline (Waves 1–11 on `main`): narration, deterministic graphics drawn by code, provenance of every on-screen fact, owner approval by hash, the held-stage refusal. Wave 12's 3D and shorts work is on an unmerged frozen branch.

Every claim keeps the labels of `MASTER-PLAN.md` (**[OFFICIAL POLICY]**, **[DOCUMENTED RECOMMENDATION]**, **[INDUSTRY PRACTICE]**, **[INFERENCE]**; **ESTIMATE**, **MEASURED**). Vietnamese first-party pages (TikTok Shop Vietnam Seller/Affiliate Center and Academy, Shopee Affiliate Vietnam, Vietnamese government legal texts) are the standard; a third-party figure is never the sole basis for a rule or a revenue number.

### RESEARCH QUESTIONS

1. **Eligibility and onboarding, per platform (Vietnam).** Age, residency, identity verification (CCCD / eKYC), follower or activity minimums, account type (personal vs business), tax code requirement, payout method and currency, payout threshold and timing. What the CEO must do personally; what an agent may never do (create accounts, handle credentials).
2. **Commission and fees.** First-party commission structure by category (open vs targeted/seller-set plans on TikTok Shop; Shopee's category rates and extra commissions), attribution window, what voids a commission (returns, cancellations, self-purchase), platform fees and deductions. Every figure dated.
3. **Content rules.** Each platform's rules for affiliate/shoppable content in Vietnam: disclosure labelling, unoriginal or reused content, AI-generated content labelling, what product footage and claims are allowed (health, cosmetics, supplements, children's products), posting limits, link and live-stream rules, and what gets an account restricted.
4. **Vietnamese law.** The affiliate/advertising disclosure obligations under the Law on Advertising and its amendments, e-commerce decrees and consumer-protection rules as they apply to an individual affiliate; personal income tax on affiliate commissions (who withholds, at what rate, thresholds) and any household-business registration trigger. Where first-party text cannot settle a point, say so and name it for local counsel; do not infer law.
5. **Content form options.** At least three, each costed and risk-rated against question 3: (a) real product footage shot by a person (samples: free sample programmes, buying, returning); (b) graphics drawn by code from product images and recorded product facts, reusing the delivered pipeline; (c) a mix. For each: what the platforms' originality rules say, what top-earning Vietnamese affiliate content of that form looks like (observed, cited), the CEO's time per video, and production cost per video. No generative model is assumed; if an option needs one, say so and price it separately.
6. **Product niche.** Two to four candidate categories for the pilot ranked on first-party commission, demand evidence, return/refund risk, claim and regulatory risk, and fit with options in question 5.
7. **Economics.** Break-even per month as a formula and as an ESTIMATE with stated assumptions (views per video, click-through, conversion, average order value, commission net of fees and tax), against the existing monthly budget (USD 77.41, metered ceiling USD 34.42). Which assumptions have no source; how the pilot would measure them in its first 30 days.
8. **What `CEO-D-1300` supersedes.** For `D-005`, `D-007`, `D-008`, `D-022` and `D-021`: keep, amend or supersede, each with its reason, for the owner to rule. What of the delivered pipeline the pilot reuses, and what Waves 12/13 would contribute if unfrozen.

### DELIVERABLE

A research report in this folder with a **recommendation**: platforms and order (TikTok Shop, Shopee, or both, and why), the content form, the niche, the first 30-day pilot plan with the measurements it takes, the CEO's personal actions (account, verification, samples), the open legal points for counsel, and the decisions the owner must take. Options and a recommendation, never a single unexamined path.

### NOT IN THIS RESEARCH

Opening any account, signing up for any programme, contacting sellers, buying samples, downloading tools or assets, building code, or publishing. Any platform other than TikTok and Shopee in Vietnam except as a short comparison. Changes to the frozen Wave 12 branch or to MC-14.

### BINDING CONSTRAINTS CARRIED FORWARD

1. **Nothing publishes**; `D-002` per-publication approval stands.
2. The CEO is the individual creator and carries the legal position (`D-018`); agents never create accounts or touch credentials.
3. Budget USD 77.41 per month, metered ceiling USD 34.42, unless the research recommends a change for the owner to approve.
4. No invented figure on screen or in the report: every number is sourced or labelled ESTIMATE with its arithmetic.
5. Affiliate disclosure is a standing rule (`D-021`) until Vietnamese law is established.

### FRAMEWORK DEFECTS TO BRIEF EVERY SUBAGENT ON

All in `research/framework-defects.md`. Give every agent its own staging folder, never brief a non-implementing role to write a repository file, and require the list whenever an agent claims a finding covers "every" case.

## Metadata

- Subject: Affiliate pilot research on TikTok Shop and Shopee in Vietnam

- Decision owner: The CEO approves the research recommendation, chooses the content form, and rules on the supersession list. The Framing Gate is decided by product-owner (see Handoff).
- Workflow phase: research-framing

## Business Context

- Business intent: Move the company's revenue line from advertising on long-form explainer video toward affiliate revenue, with TikTok Shop affiliate and Shopee Affiliate in Vietnam as the pilot that becomes the model. Research comes first. Nothing is built, opened, downloaded, or published until the owner approves the recommendation. The frozen Wave 12 and Wave 13 work is held, not cancelled.
- Problem statement: The owner judges that the current video path cannot earn money. The business needs research-backed answers on platforms, eligibility, commission, rules, law, content form, niche, economics, and the decisions the pivot reopens, so that an affiliate pilot can be approved or rejected before any build.
- Affected stakeholders: The CEO, as the individual creator who carries the legal position and approves each publication. The platforms are external parties and are not decision owners.
- Current-state pain: As supplied, the advertising path waits on partner-programme thresholds the company has not started toward. The monthly budget is USD 77.41 with a metered ceiling of USD 34.42. No revenue figure is supplied (see Q-003).

repositoryWrites.scope: none. The only files this agent writes are the artifact path and the result envelope path the invocation envelope names.
repositoryWrites.rationale: The role exists to state what is true now. An agent that also changed the repository would be reading, in part, its own work, and every observation drawn from a file it had just edited would carry a confidence the source cannot support. Reading is unrestricted inside the frozen context slice; writing is confined to the report.

commandExecution.purpose: none. Evidence is gathered by reading sources, not by executing them. A behavior that can only be established by running something is recorded as a gap and routed to the role whose phase may run it.
prohibitedPurposes: any command that modifies the repository or committed run evidence
executing the system under discovery in order to observe it

determinism.contract: Identical inputs and an identical context snapshot must produce the same observation set, the same confidence and staleness marking, the same contradiction and gap set, the same options, the same recommendation, and the same declared report status and confidence.
determinism.orderingRule: Observations keep the order their sources were read in, which is the source order Stage 3 of the reasoning procedure fixes. Options are ordered by descending evidential support, counted as the number of distinct observations cited; ties break toward the lower option identifier.
determinism.modelIndependence: No module may reference a specific model, vendor, or agent runtime. Technology names are permitted only when they trace to a source this report cites.

model_tier.basis: declared light for research/technical-validation in config/model-tier-policy.json

escalation.reason: 1 validator rejection(s) and 0 gate rejection(s) with rollback recorded for this phase; promoted from light to standard
